description: Election Commission - Declare that U. M. K. P. Aberathna was Selected as a member of the Kandy Municipale Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Kandy Municipal Council due to the death of a member, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member by a recognized political party and the subsequent declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and local authority elections, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification.
